title: The Lantern Shop

new_characters.name: Mira Han
new_characters.role: Protagonist, granddaughter of the lantern shop owner
new_characters.appearance: young Korean woman, early 20s, slim, fair skin, oval face, large dark brown eyes, straight black hair in a shoulder-length bob with blunt bangs, small mole under left eye
new_characters.outfit: oversized grey knit cardigan over a white t-shirt, dark jeans, red sneakers

new_characters.name: Joon Seo
new_characters.role: Mira's friend who works at the shop
new_characters.appearance: young Korean man, mid 20s, tall and lanky, tan skin, narrow face, sharp eyes behind round wire glasses, messy wavy brown hair
new_characters.outfit: rolled-up white shirt, brown leather work apron

panels.location: rainy old street in Harbor City with a small lantern shop
panels.action: Heavy rain over narrow street, warm light glowing from the lantern shop window
panels.mood: moody blue rain, warm window glow
panels.narration: Rain had not stopped in Harbor City for eleven days.

panels.location: inside the lantern shop, hundreds of lanterns hanging from the ceiling
panels.action: Mira pushes the door open, soaked, a brass bell swinging above the door

panels.location: inside the lantern shop, hundreds of lanterns hanging from the ceiling
panels.action: Joon behind the wooden counter polishing a brass lantern, not looking up

panels.location: inside the lantern shop, hundreds of lanterns hanging from the ceiling
panels.action: Mira shaking water from her sleeves, annoyed expression

panels.location: inside the lantern shop, hundreds of lanterns hanging from the ceiling
panels.action: Over Mira's shoulder, Joon slides a small wooden box across the counter

dialogue.speaker: Joon Seo
dialogue.text: Something came for you. No return address.

panels.location: inside the lantern shop, hundreds of lanterns hanging from the ceiling
panels.action: Hands opening a box: a palm-sized lantern wrapped in black silk begins to glow softly
panels.narration: It was cold. Then, slowly, it began to glow.

summary: In rain-soaked Harbor City, Mira Han arrives late at her grandmother's lantern shop, where her friend Joon Seo gives her an anonymous package. Inside is a tiny cold lantern that starts to glow.
